projects.title: Market Brief Agents
projects.subtitle: Agentic market research-to-video pipeline
description: Local-first AI engineering system that turns market events into evidence-grounded short-form financial briefings using source review, RAG retrieval, agent orchestration, and validation gates.
The public demo path uses synthetic data and deterministic fallbacks, with audit bundles, typed script manifests, a Streamlit operations dashboard, a Next.js shell, and Remotion rendering.

projects.title: Hate Meme Detection
projects.subtitle: Multimodal BERT, ViT, fusion, and Gemini experiments
description: Reproducible research codebase for multimodal hate meme detection across text-only BERT, image-only Vision Transformer, ViT+BERT fusion, and Gemini prompting baselines.
Refactors experiment scripts into a package with shared data loading, configs, training loops, evaluation metrics, prompt templates, and smoke tests that run without private datasets or API calls.

projects.title: Semantic Resume Screening / TalentAI
projects.subtitle: Resume parsing and semantic candidate matching modules
description: Standalone AI modules for resume parsing, candidate summarization, skill extraction, and job-candidate matching through semantic embeddings and hybrid ranking.
Includes FastAPI interfaces, command-line workflows, Groq and local LLM provider support, and a recommendation system built around Sentence-BERT similarity plus skill and title alignment.

projects.title: Semantic Search Benchmarking
projects.subtitle: LSA, LDA, GloVe, and SBERT retrieval comparison
description: Benchmarking project comparing classical topic models and dense transformer embeddings for semantic search over MS MARCO-style document retrieval tasks.
Implements LSA, LDA, GloVe, and SBERT retrieval workflows with query scripts and evaluation metrics including precision, recall, F1, average precision, and MAP.

projects.title: CEBERT
projects.subtitle: Causal regularization for robust hate speech detection
description: Official implementation of the AACL-IJCNLP 2022 paper on robust hate speech detection through mitigation of spurious correlations.
Uses a causal graph view of text classification and an entropy-regularized objective to improve robustness against word-level and character-level adversarial attacks.

projects.title: MDL-MLM
projects.subtitle: Minimum description length analysis for adversarial NLP
description: Official repository for the Entropy 2024 article studying implications of minimum description length for adversarial attacks in natural language processing.
Provides workflows for perturbation data preparation, masked language model fine-tuning, fill-mask generation, and MDL computation across causal and anticausal directions.
